evidence.note: User reaches for the closed entry-closet door handle.
Closet door is open and the closet contents are exposed.
User grasps the door to close it.
Closet door is closed again.
User grasps the closed microwave door handle.
Microwave door is open.
User pushes the microwave door toward the appliance.
Microwave door is closed.
User pulls the oven handle and the door begins opening.
Oven door is fully open and the illuminated interior is visible.
Oven door remains open as the user begins closing it.
Oven door is closed.
User reaches toward the dishwasher handle.
Dishwasher door is open and the racks are visible.
User pushes the dishwasher door closed.
Dishwasher door is closed.
User reaches to the center seam of the closed two-leaf upper cabinet.
The left cabinet leaf is swung outward.
Both cabinet leaves remain open immediately before closure.
Cabinet front is closed again.

evidence.note: Both leaves of the upper cabinet appear closed before manipulation.
The cabinet interior is exposed with the right leaf swung outward.
Right cabinet leaf remains open.
Both cabinet leaves have been closed.

events.object_description: Right leaf of the upper cabinet above the sink/cutting board

evidence.note: User grasps the handle of the closed lower drawer beside the refrigerator.
Drawer is extended open.
Drawer remains open immediately before closure.
Drawer is closed flush with the cabinetry.

evidence.note: User grasps the upper refrigerator-door handle.
Upper refrigerator compartment is open and illuminated.
Refrigerator door remains open.
User swings the upper door closed.
Upper refrigerator door is closed.
User grasps the lower freezer-door handle.
Lower freezer door is open and the freezer interior is visible.
User begins closing the open freezer door.
Lower freezer door is closed.
Laundry-closet door is closed.
Door has opened, revealing the stacked washer and dryer.
Laundry-closet door remains open.
User pulls the door toward the closed position.
Laundry-closet door is closed.

notes: Ten movable-part episodes are visible. The paired upper-cabinet leaves are reported separately because they are distinct movable parts, although the 8-frame sampling does not clearly resolve their individual opening and closing order.
scene_description: A user surveys a studio apartment and then sequentially manipulates an entry closet door, kitchen appliances and storage, the refrigerator/freezer, and a laundry-closet door.
